summary: kanyut@1.0.0: weak static pattern match without corroborating evidence of installer harm
details: A a static rule matched on keyword co-occurrence (ping, GET, id) across widely separated lines in lib/Utils/generics.js. The matched tokens are consistent with ordinary HTTP client code and identifier handling within a utility module; no traced code path was identified that reads installer-side secrets (env vars, ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser stores) or forwards them to an attacker-controlled destination, and no install-time lifecycle hook (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) or top-level side-effect execution was observed. The evidence available does not demonstrate an attacker benefit against a party installing the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
